rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education or in-service education applicable to nursing practice
rules.alternatives: CE is only one item on the Board's continued-competence list; the nurse keeps a personal file with at least two items per renewal period, e.g. employer or peer evaluation, contract renewal, written self-evaluation, national certification, a goal-based learning plan, nursing volunteer work, a published article, a 2-week refresher or orientation program, nursing school enrollment, or retaking NCLEX, or (RN only) teaching nursing students.
rules.new_licensee_rule: For initial licensees, meeting the licensure requirements counts as proof of competence.
rules.audit_note: Nurses attest to keeping a competence file; keep documentation 4 years and provide it within 30 days of a Board request.
rules.notes: Renewal due by the last day of the birth month, every two years. 10 contact hours alone does not satisfy the rule (two items needed). A $10 biennial state regulatory fee is added to the renewal fee. tn.gov pages block automated reading; data taken from the official rules chapter.
